audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Akshan Level 1 and Level 6 and called Level 2 a skill lane, against a 55.45% Yasuo win rate over 981 games and against the packet chart (Skill at 1, Yasuo every row after).
audit.why: Level 1 is genuinely even — Akshan hipfires Avengerang before Yasuo has E. From 2 onward Wind Wall answers his entire ranged kit, and at 6 Comeuppance is a projectile the wall deletes while Last Breath off a two-stack tornado ends him.
audit.corrected: Level 1 reads Skill; Levels 2 through 2+ items read Yasuo. Rows proposed as a matched full+content group.

audit.why: Spike windows are correct — Yasuo at 3-5 once E is online, at 6, on first crit item and late. Only the level-6 phase text needed the mechanical reason.
audit.corrected: Windows unchanged; phases[4].why now names the Airborne requirement on Last Breath and the wall vs Comeuppance.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry listed Wind Wall as eating 'his entire ranged kit — Q and R' but repeatedly treated Heroic Swing as a safe escape/engage Yasuo can only punish on cooldown. Going Rogue's camouflage was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot flags Heroic Swing as a projectile: the shots he fires while swinging are projectiles too, so a wall laid across the arc blanks the whole swing, not just his poke. Going Rogue (W) is camouflage with a 5500 range — Yasuo has no reveal in his kit, so a sweeper and Control Wards are mandatory.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall blocks Avengerang, Comeuppance AND the mid-swing shots of Heroic Swing. Added the vision requirement for Going Rogue to wants.you[2].

audit.why: Packet flagged 'His Comeuppance' in spikes[1] as a probable wrong name. False positive — Comeuppance is the real R name; the matched token was just the preceding word.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akshan's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Last Breath needs you Airborne first, so count Q stacks. Comeuppance is a projectile — your wall blanks the whole burst.

edits.before: Once you have E you outmatch Akshan hard: Wind Wall completely eats his Avengerang (Q) and Comeuppance (R) — his entire ranged threat — so he can't poke you at all. E-Q onto him through minions and he has to burn Heroic Swing (E) to escape, which you can punish. This is a 55% matchup for a reason.
edits.after: Once you have E you outmatch Akshan hard: Wind Wall completely eats his Avengerang (Q) and Comeuppance (R) — his entire ranged threat — so he can't poke you at all. E-Q onto him through minions and he has to burn Heroic Swing (E) to escape. Its swing shots are projectiles too — a wall across the arc blanks it.

edits.before: Levels 2-6 belong to you. Wind Wall eats his entire ranged kit — Q and R — and E-Q lets you gap-close and punish his Heroic Swing cooldown. Wall his poke, stick to him, and he can't trade back.
edits.after: Levels 2-6 belong to you. Wind Wall eats his Q, his R and the shots he fires mid-Heroic-Swing, and E-Q punishes his 18s swing cooldown. Wall his poke, stick to him, and he can't trade back.

edits.before: Track his roams so he can't snowball the map
edits.after: Sweeper and pinks — Going Rogue is camouflage

notes: Heroic Swing's projectile status is the same class of gap as the Azir/Yasuo Wind Wall omission called out in the calibration notes — the page told the player to punish the swing on cooldown when they can simply blank it. Left spikes[3] and late alone: they already read correctly.
